operations.title: Benincasa reports failure of the plus-four triangle-wall cofinal step
operations.body: The validated fast reduction for (A,K)=(10,3)->(14,4) is complete. Target ranks are (19267,17,18). Of 26 source-derived connection probes, 24 retain nonzero remainder; only source basis direction 6 vanishes under both tangents. Thus the degree-derived (+4,+1) step does not restore finite-cutoff descent. This is not a colimit obstruction. Entry 1058 records the narrow theorem and proposes deriving the next staircase bound from primitive/exact-lift valuations rather than deg T(K) alone.
